The brief facts relevant for disposal of this Rule are that one Mojibur Rahman, the predecessor of the opposite party Nos. 11-20 as plaintiffs filed a suit for specific performance of contract in the Court of learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Gazipur being Title Suit No. 10 of 1996 on the averments that the father of defendant Nos. 1-8, late Kazi Abdul Halim executed a bainanama on 2-3-1991 receiving Taka 2,00,000 out of Taka 2,10,000 from the plaintiff Mazibur Rahman in respect of 5.05 acres of land of CS Khatian No. 13 under Pagar Mouza, Police Station, Tongi, District-Gazipur but after the death of Kazi Abdul Halim his heirs did not come forward to execute the deed as per terms of bainanama dated 2-3-1991 and hence the suit. 

 12. Drawing my attention to the paragraph Nos. 8, 9, 10 and 11 of the plaint Mr Abul Hossein, submits that the plaintiffs clearly stated in the plaint that the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 1-8, late Kazi Abdul Halim executed a bainanama on 2-3-1991 receiving Taka 2,00,000 out of Taka 2,10,000 from the plaintiff Mazibur Rahman in respect of 5.05 acres of land of CS Khatian No. 13 under Pagar Mouza, Police Station, Tongi, District Gazipur and after the death of Kazi Abdul Halim the defendant Nos. 1-8 as legal heirs of Kazi Abdul Halim did not come forward to execute the deed as per bainanama and then the plaintiff served a legal notice upon the defendants to execute the deed as per bainanama and in spite of that defendants did not do so and in view of such positive and specific averments of the plaint the application for rejection of plaint on the ground that the plaint does not disclose any cause of action for the suit is plainly misconceived and unwanted whatsoever. 

 13. I have heard the learned Advocates of both the sides, perused the judgments of 2 Courts below and other materials on record. To appreciate the submissions of the learned Advocates from a correct angle let me see first whether the plaint at all disclosed a cause of action for suit. I have examined the contents of the plaint, it appears that there is positive averment in the plaint that late Kazi Abdul Halim, the predecessor of the defendants executed a bainanama on 2-3-1991 receiving Take 2,00,000 out of Taka 2,10,000 from the plaintiff Mazibur Rahman in respect of 5.05 acres of land of CS Khatian No. 13 under Pager Mouza, Police Station, Tongi, District-Gazipur and after the death of Kazi Abdul Halim the defendant Nos. 1-8 as legal heirs of Kazi Abdul Halim did not come forward to execute the deed as per bainanama.
